testCase:
G-037: Sold-out sizes as aria-disabled buttons
Goal: Add the Ospreyfield home shirt in size M to the bag.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p37.html
STEP 2: Verify that the "XL" button is disabled
STEP 3: Verify that the "M" button is enabled
STEP 4: Click the "M" button
STEP 5: Verify that 'Size M selected' is visible
STEP 6: Click the "Add to bag" button
STEP 7: Verify that 'Added to bag: Ospreyfield home shirt, size M' is visible

plan.title: G-037: Sold-out size refusal and size M purchase

steps.note: Assert that the sold-out XL button refuses interaction.
Select M; this step also fails if the button is disabled.
Add the selected shirt to the bag.

args.text: Added to bag: Ospreyfield home shirt, size M

steps.note: Confirm the correct shirt and size were added.

reasoning: This tests that sold-out XL refuses interaction while enabled size M can be selected and added to the bag. The plan uses a refused-click assertion for XL, a successful click for M, and exact visible-text checks for selection and bag confirmation.
